games.name: Apex Legends Mobile
games.gameplay: Fast-paced squad-based battle royale featuring iconic Legends, tactical abilities, and wall-running movement. High skill ceiling with advanced mobility — glide, slide, and zip-line like a pro 💪🔥. Sadly, it’s now a legend of the past.

games.name: PUBG Mobile
games.gameplay: The OG battle royale with massive maps, realistic shooting mechanics, vehicles, and survival strategy. Perfect for tense moments, chicken dinners, and squad coordination 🐔🏆. Runs on nearly every Android & iOS device.

games.name: PUBG Mobile
games.battery: Moderate drain; more if you drive vehicles 🏎️

faqs.question: Can I play Apex Legends Mobile today?
faqs.answer: No ❌ Servers were shut down in 2023, so the game is no longer playable.

faqs.question: Which game should I pick in 2026?
faqs.answer: PUBG Mobile 🏆 — active servers, constant updates, and competitive gameplay.

faqs.question: Which game had better mobility?
faqs.answer: Apex Legends Mobile 💨 — legendary movement, wall-sliding, and zip-lines.

faqs.question: Which game is better for long-term play?
faqs.answer: PUBG Mobile — stable progression, Royale Pass rewards, and strong esports support 🔥
